title: Starway to Urf
description: A poppy, pulpy sci fi comedy. Play as Susie, a plucky young woman who has to escape her job as an intergalactic au-pair before setting off into a broken universe in search of the fabled Starway to Urf. A point and click adventure about living with heart and finding friends in a broken universe.

title: Tower of Gand Demo
description: A dungeon-crawling RPG where death means losing everything. Explore a dungeon by revealing 5×5 panels, with enemies and events changing every run. In turn-based battles, strategy decides survival, and madness erodes your sanity. Master over 40 classes and conquer the Tower of Gand.

title: Super SteamPuff: Double Reload Demo
description: Try the Super SteamPuff: Double Reload demo and dive into frantic arcade action! Play as 8 quirky Puffs, battle bizarre bosses, survive Endless Mode, and challenge your friends in chaotic local multiplayer.

title: AMIMI Demo
description: Play the opening of AMIMI, a hand-crafted adventure where a child and a mysterious creature explore a magical world, solve inventive puzzles, and discover a story of friendship, transformation, and nature.

title: The Uncovering - Demo
description: In a modern city's daily life, become detective Sylva, interview suspects face-to-face, catch cracks in their words, use evidence to shatter composure. Shift between viewpoints, gather fragments, trace connections, peel away twisted lies and fixations—until the truth surfaces.

title: LOOP SYNDROME Demo
description: There are no second chances in medicine. A medical suspense visual novel where a young doctor gains the power to rewind time. Use the loop to change the fate of diagnoses, surgeries, and emergency treatments. Your choices shape the story, leading to multiple Bad, Good, and True Endings.

title: The Sunless Throne Demo
description: Raise an expedition guild—not just one hero—in this top-down expedition roguelite. Rotate multiple parties, explore procedural dungeons, and command row-based turn-based battles as you descend through five sealed gates.

title: Nutshot Simulator Demo
description: A comedy physics shooting gallery: throw stuff, nail zany characters, and watch them ragdoll across mundane-yet-absurd locations. Unlock new areas by clearing targets off your list. Just you, a sackful of projectiles, and a deeply questionable hobby.

title: Malware Buster Demo
description: MalwareBuster is a survivor-like Roguelite game that delivers ultimate bullet-heaven satisfaction. Step into an infected virtual host as the ultimate antivirus program! Strengthen yourself, freely customize builds with diverse skills and items, and purge all malware in high-octane combat!

title: BOKUKAN5 TOKYO (HND) I am an Air Traffic Controller Demo
description: The latest air traffic control puzzle is here! Set at Tokyo International Airport (HND/RJTT), experience two ways to enjoy the airport: Air Traffic Control Puzzle and the all-new Terminal Side. BOKUKAN evolves into a game where you can immerse yourself in the airport experience.

title: FLIPSWEEPER Demo
description: Welcome to FLIPSWEEPER, a pure, bite-sized logic puzzle experience designed to test your deduction skills and your speed. If you love grid-based puzzle games but crave focused, individual challenges rather than giant, overwhelming boards, you are in the right place.

title: Squimo Demo
description: This is a short, incremental game about eliminating Squimo.

title: Soul Ripple Demo
description: Sherlock and 9 other individuals are forced to participate in a mysterious experiment, the purpose of which is unclear. Why are they here, and what is in store for them? The mysteries of the odd facility and even themselves may unfold in unexpected ways….

title: Lord of Lords: Dawn of the King Demo
description: Betrayed in the Amazon, an elite Korean special forces commander crosses into a brutal fantasy world and rises as a lord. A dark military-fantasy visual novel with choices, light progression, and conquest.

title: Huiyu Party Run Demo
description: Huiyu Party Run is a feel-good party game built for get-togethers — no skill ceiling, no long grind, just grab your friends, hit start, and the fun is already happening

title: Four-Dimensional Demo
description: game

title: LOTTERY Demo
description: LOTTERY's Demo allows you to experience the groundbreaking AI in a shrunken version, with the same adaptation and predictions in a tactical first person shooter format.

title: Chronicles of the Fallen Realm Demo
description: Nine Hero classes. Five Acts of darkness. One Shadow Lord. Chronicles of the Fallen Realm is a dark fantasy turn-based RPG roguelite where defeat fuels your rise. Upgrade your Heroes, master unique skills, and push deeper into the Fallen Realm each run.

title: Nuts Pipeline Demo
description: Deliver nuts to the hamster at the goal! Switch converters on the pipes each turn to create the right combination. Clear 10 turns per level within a 3-minute limit. Starting easy for anyone, this endless puzzle grows harder with every level.

title: Roomrush Racer Demo
description: Experience the fast-paced chaos of Roomrush Racer in this free demo. Race across 3 room-sized tracks, choose from several hover racers, use wild items, and play solo or with up to 4 players in local split-screen.

title: Kagenazo Demo
description: Arrange cubes, match the shadows, and solve relaxing 3D spatial puzzles.

title: Reality Engine Demo
description: José, a Newell's Old Boys fan, breaks the "reality" and travels to different alternate realities. Will he manage to get back home? Find out in this crazy game!

title: Renovation Simulator Demo
description: The demo contains 2 houses. A small and large, with the current selection of products to choose from.

title: EggOS: Incremental Game Dev Demo
description: The bank wants a million dollars or your house. Boot up EggOS, a playable fake desktop, and make games to pay it back: coding, dart-throwing, slot machines, mini-games, and a deep prestige tree. Beat the bank, then do it all again, faster.

title: Combo Break Demo
description: Combo Break fuses the hypnotic pull of a peg-bouncer with roguelite deckbuilding. Load your board with special pegs, chain their effects into screen-filling combos, and watch the payouts explode. One more ball. One bigger combo. One perfect board.

title: Thorner Demo
description: Thorner is a horror visual novel with multiple endings. You attempt to escape your past by fleeing to the wilderness, but spilled blood can never be forgiven. The land knows what you did. The land judges. Thorner awaits.

title: When Two Roses Collide Demo
description: A BL visual novel set during the War of the Roses. Will love prevail over honour?

title: Gallop Diva Demo
description: The Gallop Diva Demo includes the complete first chapter of the game. Step into a prestigious girls’ equestrian academy and experience story-driven horse racing, character conflicts, and the protagonist’s first major challenge. This demo includes Cantonese and Mandarin voice acting.
developer: Gamemiracle Co. Ltd., Genuine Studio Ltd

title: My Own Hero Party Demo
description: Build a party of up to 3 characters in a casual incremental auto-combat game. Cross 20-room expeditions, use targeted abilities, grow through a persistent upgrade tree, and reach the boss before your stamina runs out.

title: 何以情堪·飞翔五十二里 Demo
description: 在一个本该平凡的周五，您与念白请假从西安前往广州参加婚礼，在前往高铁站的地铁上，似乎因为早上吃了不怎么干净的食物，导致有些腹泻，恰好站站有厕所，于是你们开启了“飞翔五十二里”的旅程。念白看似状态良好，但她似乎在隐瞒什么？当“从韦曲南8到北客站”真实上演，您能否掌控全局，带领念白平安抵达北客站呢？

title: Hunter: The Reckoning — Day For Night Demo
description: These monsters aren’t just in the movies! Will you hunt the vampires, werewolves and others stalking Hollywood, or will you become a monster instead?

title: 東方天流宮 ~ Heavenly Gathering of Clouds Demo
developer: Dream Compass, スタジオネネム

title: Welcome, Dear Human Demo
description: A choice-driven story where you meet real monsters, navigate their strange rules, and decide how far you’ll go to form a connection without losing your humanity.

title: Hemlon the Grey Demo
description: Hemlon the Grey is a deflection-based 2D Souls-like where life and death are decided by a blade. Follow the story of Hemlon, a half-demon warrior, as she uncovers the dark secrets of the Reinz Republic and the Broken Wings.

title: SCP Idle: SECURE. CONTAIN. PROGRESS. Demo
description: In this incremental game you are in charge of managing a SCP facility site. Construct and upgrade new containment chambers and keep your facility running.

title: Lonely Dung Beetle Demo
description: A cozy isometric little game where a lonely dung beetle rolls, collects, and grows one little world at a time. Roll your dung ball across peaceful meadows, gather everything nature leaves behind.

title: The Wake Event Demo
description: Awaken aboard ARGUS Station and uncover the first signs of the Wake Event. This demo includes Modules 01-03, introducing exploration, environmental clues, terminal puzzles, subnet isolation, routing, and the station’s unsettling observation systems.

title: Possessed Kingdom Demo
description: Defend your kingdom or rush the enemy in this Deckbuilding RTS. Build your base, scale your economy, and draw custom paths for your troops to break enemy defenses. Win battles, steal the king's cards, and build the ultimate deck.

title: Undercover Love - Where Shadows Meet Demo
description: A dark noir visual novel following Alex, a former police officer drawn into the mafia’s world. In a city where trust can get you killed and everyone has something to hide, Alex and a mafia leader with buried secrets are pulled into revenge, power, and slow-burn romance shaped by your choices.

title: Isle of Titans Demo
description: Isle of Titans is an idle tower defense game where you defend a small kingdom against giant invaders. Shape your build with long-term progression between runs, and adapt on the fly during each run to hold back endless waves of Titans.

title: Bobo and the Chest of Nightmares Demo
description: Jump, glide, and outsmart traps in this spooky 3D platformer! Smash obstacles, solve puzzles, and fend off evil spirits to defeat The Dream Master. Collect hidden treasures and restore joy to a world shrouded in darkness!

title: Deep Within the Mist: Prologue
description: "Deep Within the Mist" is a 2D narrative-driven RPG. In a distant past, a sudden “Calamity” nearly destroyed Earth. Thick mists erupted across the world. Gazing upon the desolate land, a determined girl named Ruo Xi steps into the mist, seeking a way to end the Calamity.

title: The Legend of Celia Demo
description: fantasy dungeon RPG. Explore ruins, collect crystals, rebuild civilization. Real-time turn-based combat, 5 heroes front/back rows, magitech support. 11 classes, talent trees, summons. Roguelike: billions random gear stats, rune forging, Obelisk Stones. Hardcore strategy.

title: Shadow over Bishkek Demo
description: Shadow Over Bishkek Demo is a 3D Action/RPG with the top down camera view. A student from Bishkek gains the superpower to travel to the Darkland and interact with ghosts. During the day, he lives an ordinary life of a student, but at night, he fights evil spirits.

title: Pichhal Peri Demo
description: ABOUT THIS DEMOA haveli frozen since 1985. No one who enters ever leaves. Dare to face the darkness of an abandoned Indian heritage haveli — where Pichhal Peri hunts you through every shadow, every corridor, and every room.This is a playable demo of Pichhal Peri.

title: Graveyard Shift: A Sage's Last Stand Demo
description: A dark pixel-art roguelike deckbuilder. You're the mortician the night the dead stop staying dead — turn every corpse into cards, forge them to Ascended rank, and survive 21 nights, three rule-breaking bosses, and one thing that was never meant to have a name.

title: INKUBO Demo
description: Eve, who suffers from sleep issues and nightmares, takes pills from Dr. Isaac that put her into REM sleep. She becomes trapped in a loop inside a distorted, other-dimensional version of her own home. She must find anomalies, make the right choices, and survive deadly entities to break the cycle.

title: Slots & Skulls Demo
description: A turn-based roguelite built on a slot machine. Spin to attack, collect the symbols that drop, and upgrade them at the anvil (or lose them permanently).

title: Wrathflame Demo
description: A dark fantasy themed 2D top down real-time bullet hell shooter featuring retro Pico8 pixel graphics and chiptunes

title: Tinturbo Demo
description: Tinturbo is a single player 2D Top-Down racer with procedurally generated tracks

title: The Offering Hour Demo
description: In an arena watched by gods and demons, you are the Sacrificer. Time is your only currency — and your life: summon monsters, utter dark rites, wear the monster's skin, all paid in the hours you have left. A strategy-action roguelike. One gate — only one side walks free.

title: Hardcourt Balls - Qualifiers
description: Experience the first taste of Hardcourt Balls, a turn-based tennis strategy game where dice, skill cards, and tactical decisions determine every rally. Play exhibition matches against a selection of opponents and discover whether you have what it takes to dominate the court.

title: Clean Those Carpets! - Carpet Cleaning Simulator Demo
description: Ever seen a video of someone cleaning a really filthy carpet? This game is exactly that! A satisfying process of cleaning a carpet from filthy to perfectly spotless.

title: Fruit Store Simulator Demo
description: Stock it, price it, sell it, and turn a small corner fruit shop into the neighborhood's favorite fruit store.

title: Maxwell's Odyssey Demo
description: Explore the dungeons of an ancient castle in search of a vanished sorceress. Blast through monsters, solve puzzles, and dodge the deadly traps waiting inside.

title: Book Organizer  Demo
description: 📚 주요 특징 (Key Features)정돈이 주는 아늑한 쾌감: 만족스러운 ASMR 사운드와 함께 책을 종류별, 분류 기준에 따라 착착 정렬하는 손맛을 느낄 수 있습니다.나만의 공간 채우기: 책장에 책을 직접 알맞게 배치하며 효율적이고 깔끔하게 꾸며나갑니다. 완벽하게 정돈된 서가를 보며 카타르시스를 느껴보세요.힐링과 도전의 완벽한 밸런스: 잔잔한 배경음악 속에서 온전히 공간에만 집중하는 미니멀 플레이부터, 플레이어를 방해하는 빌런들을 피해 제한 시간 내에 완벽을 추구하는 하드코어 모드까지 취향에 맞는 플레이를 제공합니다.

title: Steel Maiden Demo
description: Two buttons. Pure, explosive speed. A lightning-fast action roguelite you play with just two buttons. Forge your own combat style with builds that shift every run, and chase that rush of pure dopamine through gorgeous visuals.

title: AstroSki Demo
description: Astro Ski is a VR Arcade game that takes players to race on skis in different planetary environments, with unique features for each planet!

title: Unorthodox Rules Demo
description: A mystery-comedy deduction adventure about surviving deadly rule-based games. In this demo, investigate clues, expose contradictions, and outthink your opponent in an unfair game of rock-paper-scissors.

title: Susanoo: Typing Action Demo
description: A Sekiro-like typing game. Defeat enemies through typing and parry their attacks with precise timing.

title: Swarmhold Demo
description: Swarmhold is a base defense roguelite where you survive the relentless swarm. Gather resources, build your defenses, draft in-game upgrades, and fight alongside your base to hold the line. Play solo or with up to 3 friends.

title: Fox Idle Demo
description: Go on an adventure with cute fox-eared companions! Gather resources, craft gear, fight monsters, complete quests, and most importantly, make progress together with foxgirls in this incremental idle RPG.

title: Railroad Rummy Demo
description: A classic multiplayer rummy card game where you draw, discard, build winning hands, and outplay friends and family in tense, easy-to-learn matches inspired by real camping table traditions.

title: Grindbound Demo
description: A single-player, top-down 3D auto-looter set in a dark fantasy world. Explore dungeons, defeat enemies, collect randomized gear, and combine skills and equipment to create powerful builds. No complex controls or quick reflexes required.

title: Pixel Evolution Demo
description: A twin-stick arena shooter where every run rebuilds the game itself. Collect pixels, survive the constant HP drain, and complete each upgrade checklist to COMPILE the next era — evolving from 1-bit monochrome all the way to 3D, one boss at a time.

title: BRAVERUN Demo
description: Thrilling action and epic boss battles! Dash through a 90s-style pixel world in the retro action RPG BRAVERUN — cut through hordes of enemies and face mighty foes!

title: 日本地図 都市パズル Demo
description: A massive geography puzzle with every prefecture, city, ward, town and village in Japan—over 1,700 areas, nearly 1,900 pieces! Learn towns nationwide through Puzzle, Quiz, Study, Silhouette, Mountains & Rivers and Town Fortune mo des. Full controller support, with furigana & read-aloud for all ages.

title: Idle Golf Demo
description: Idle Golf is a laid-back idle game where you upgrade your golfer, unlock powerful balls, and watch the money roll in as shots fly automatically down the range. Retire your runs to earn medals, unlock new gear, and push your earnings further with each swing.

title: Crystal Ascend Demo
description: A simple incremental game where you nurture crystal elementals by destroying floating crystals and harvesting aether. Upgrade the skill tree, unlock new abilities to gather resources faster, and build your ultimate crystal companions.

title: LoHa Adventure Remake Demo
description: Play the first two levels of LoHa Adventure Remake! Explore a colorful 2D platforming adventure, meet new allies, battle the Bird Mini Boss, and discover the beginning of LoHa's journey in this free playable demo.

title: 沧浪行卷 Demo
description: Canglang Scrolls is a single-player wuxia sandbox RPG. Explore towns, wilderness, and unknown roads. Learn martial arts, trade, craft, build, and fight in tactical turn-based battles. Your choices shape the world, relationships, and future encounters. No fixed path — your story is yours to create.

title: Handslayer Demo
description: Handslayer is a single-player roguelike built around 3 poker hands per battle. Every battle is a tactical duel where you build not one, but three hands to defeat your opponent. Collect powerful relics, discover ancient artifacts, and forge game-breaking synergies. Every hand matters.

title: Tuoni Demo
description: A turn-based Roguelike RPG set in a mythic northern wilderness. Explore procedurally generated lands, battle eerie folkloric creatures, and craft powerful builds on your journey to the land of the dead. Experiment with diverse playstyles in a richly tactical, old-school inspired adventure.

title: Cyber Pet'Scape : Call of Freedom - Demo
description: Cybernetically enhance small vulnerable animals in a pixel art hardcore roguelite platformer, where every jump, every mutation, and every mistake can decide their freedom… or their extinction.

title: Pongo! Paddle Pals! Demo
description: Pong... But it's a roguelite! The FREE demo: pick a class and a ball blessing, then paddle through Act 1 to its boss - stack chips, chase synergies, survive floor modifiers that warp the ball mid-rally. Plus bonus Targets mode. The full game unlocks all three acts. PONG! IT! UP!

title: Pentapip Demo
description: Roll. Hold. Break the rules.Roll five dice. Keep what you need. Score one category. Then turn those familiar choices into a roguelite build powerful enough to outscore five rule-changing bosses.PentaPip starts with classic roll–hold–score strategy and builds from there. Between scorecards, spend your cash on Tricks, Runes, and Sigils.

title: Dig! Dig! Dino! Demo
description: Dig Dig Dino! is a game about digging... For dinosaurs bones and other treasure!

title: Pleasure Inquisitor ~Knight Lillia's Sweet Surrender~ Demo
Mega Mouse Demo
description: Armies of AI drones are powered by massive data centers scattered across the Milky Way. Their immense power is tearing holes in space, threatening all life in the galaxy. Take command of Mega Mouse, an elite soldier on a mission to hunt down and destroy every data center before it's too late!

title: Draftula Demo
description: Build up your castle in this is a roguelike twist on the block-dropping puzzler! Place your rooms strategically to reach greater heights. Will you be able to build a fortress to stand the test of time, or will that pesky hero send your work crumbling to the ground?

title: Flaming Fried Nutrition: Daydream Demo
description: A free demo for a cute horror pet-raising game with idle elements, about a girl who loves hamburgers very, very much. Pet her beloved hamburger, feed it, dance for it, ride it. Dream of perfect happiness.

title: RiverDevil Demo
description: Play the first five floors of River Devil’s Story Tower. Read opponents, bluff, fold, raise, call, and go all-in while managing chips against demons and bosses. The Fate Wheel brings rewards, penalties and rule changes. No shops or rest stops. Fictional chips only; no real-money gambling.

title: The Magician's son ولد الساحر Demo
description: Survive a chilling night in this first-person psychological horror game. Explore eerie environments, search for hidden secrets, and use stealth mechanics to evade a relentless pursuer. Every decision matters as you navigate a dark world of mystery and tension.

title: Skijoring Demo
description: Crash into your friends in Skijoring, the unhinged sport of push and pull. Get wild airtime, screen-peek to survive, and embrace co-op chaos in the world's first, best, and only arcade skijorer.

title: Dungeon Rush Demo
description: Dungeon Rush is a 2D pixel art top-down roguelite game. Collect a variety of weapons, use numerous relics and items to survive in the dungeon, challenge powerful enemies, and prepare for the awakening of the Demon Lord deep within the dungeon.

title: Curse Of The Abandoned Floor Demo
description: Curse Of The Abandoned Floor is a first-person Chinese-style horror game. It begins with a paranormal video, telling the urban legend: “Be very careful of the non-existent elevator gap. If you accidentally enter it, you will be trapped forever.” This is a demo.

title: MAKEN Demo
description: THIS IS MAKEN DEMO

title: Zap & Andy: Go to HELL! Demo
description: A fully animated 2D gay NSFW point-and-click adventure inspired by classic genre titles! Help Zap the angel and Andy the demon make up for their lost teenage years as they try to escape from Hell—without succumbing to the many, many horny (and horned) temptations that stand between them and freedom.

title: Meat Lovers Demo
description: Grow explosive crops by day. Blow up meat lovers by night. See how many days you can last. Earn coins to unlock new areas, trade with NPCs, or gamble at the wishing well. Good luck.

title: Face The Gauntlet Demo
description: Fight your way through the colosseum and ascend its ranks in Face The Gauntlet, a turn-based action RPG. Spend points to take actions, or save them for when you parry your opponent and interrupt their turn. Weigh your options carefully and strike fiercely as one of five unique classes.

title: STARCULT. Night: Twisted Age Demo
description: Face your emotions in this dark fantasy visual novel with horror elements, set in a world on the brink of catastrophe. Will you take the Hedonistic path and indulge in pleasure until the bitter end, or will you try to save yourself and your loved ones?

title: Billionth Soul Demo
description: Try the opening act of Billionth Soul for free. Thaw humanity's first sleeper, draft cards onto the colony grid, and trade population against dwindling life support to reach Township: your first 100,000 souls. Early research tiers included. The billionth soul comes later. This is soul one.

title: Battle Birds: Cybernetic Avian Combat Demo
description: Take Flight as the Battle Birds!Flap, dash, and blast your way to victory against up to 4 friends in a hilariously intense local party game focused on skilled movement through hazardous arenas and explosive power-ups. Simple controls make it easy to jump in, but only the fiercest birds will rule the skies.

title: A Possum's Favorite Game: A Weapon? A Monster? A Child.
description: After a receiving a distress call from a young male, officer Miriam Kelly is tasked to tend to the caller's residence to further investigate the reasoning behind it.

title: Ember Folks Demo
description: Heat a dying star to millions of degrees. Mine resources, summon an army of workers, and expand your city. Discover new upgrades and synergies, prestige to unlock new mechanics, and push the heat ever higher. Numbers go up - a lot.

title: Rabbits Hunt 2 Demo
description: Rabbits Hunt 2 is a point-and-click exploration horror game set in an old Japanese house. With your partner Roppy, investigate a home tied to a family tragedy and follow strange traces toward the truth. No combat, only observation, unease, and quiet J-horror.

title: Inn Over Your Head Demo
description: An incremental game where you run a tavern with a deadly secret beneath it. Serve ale, expand your tavern, dig deeper into the dungeon below, and lure adventurers to their doom with irresistible treasure. Then harvest their souls to do it all over again. Ready to get Inn Over Your Head?

title: rock[et] Demo
description: Your rock[et] crashed on a mysterious planet. Break asteroids, collect minerals, and upgrade to escape! Discover different items, characters, synergies, and more...

title: Noël macabre Demo
description: Experience the events preceding the main game. In this two-part demo, travel from the freezing cold of an Antarctic cave to the warm comfort of a home in northern Quebec to discover how this thing arrived, or rather... returned to Earth.

title: Mana & Merlin: A Wanderful Adventure Demo
Roam Demo
description: Roam is a fantasy turn based tableau building strategy game designed by Red Raven Games. The demo is a truncated version of the basic game (no artifacts, stacking variant, or outpost). Once 3 additional characters are found for a team, whomever has the most victory points will be the winner.

title: Bungee Fisher Demo
description: Tired of ordinary fishing? In Bungee Fisher, leap from heights as a swimsuit-clad diver, plunge deep, and haul up exotic fish and treasure chests. Challenge underwater creatures and uncover lost treasure!

title: Agro Tycoon Demo
description: In this DEMO you will get a feel of the starting mechanics of the game, the starter npcs and also a part of the town, market, different neighbors and some lands for you to buy and try out the vehicles and mechanics of the game!

title: Shawarma Hell Demo
description: In Shawarma Hell, you play as a teenage part-timer trying to make ends meet by working late shifts at a grimy shawarma joint tucked away in ║̴̟͈͑▌̷̝̥̌║̷̫̳̔̔▌̸̢̅͠║̴̳͉̿͊█̵̢̣͘│̴̮͊͌▌̸̖̩̈̂. At first, the job seems boring—greasy grills, weird customers, and endless orders.

title: SPLIT FPV: Drone Racing Demo
description: SPLIT FPV is a detailed FPV drone control simulator with realistic flight physics and a drone customization system. Here you can learn to fly in a wide variety of flight modes and conditions. Explore the drone's design, experiment with the detailed customization system, and build your own drone.

title: Archaea Ascent Demo
description: Undergo trials, build your identity, build a team, build your skills, fight the system. The operators are watching — and the directives are getting harder to follow.

title: Scrappers Paradise Demo
description: A physics based incremental game about scrapping junk to collect scrap and components. Build machines and buy powerful upgrades to become more efficient.

title: Alien Bloom Demo
description: Alien Bloom is a three-player strategy game where rival factions fight for control of the world. Expand into new territory, attack your enemies, and use card games to decide every battle.

title: Dread Below Demo
description: Play the free demo of Dread Below. Descend into a procedurally generated underground facility where an intelligent creature adapts to your behavior with every floor you survive.

title: MiningCore Demo
description: Mining core is an simple incremental game about extracting and using resources from planets to buy upgrades.

title: Fuel Station Simulator Demo
description: Are you ready for a first taste of the most comprehensive fuel station simulation ever? Manage your fuel pumps, your shop, and lay the foundation for everything still to come in the full game…

title: Burnit Quest Demo
description: Get ready to blast baddies AND calories in this 2D fitness platformer!

title: MECHANICUBUS Demo
description: This is a story about a cube.

title: InternetCafe98 Demo
description: Start with one trash PC and build a packed 1998 internet cafe. Serve customers, upgrade your hardware and network, and research new tech in this retro incremental tycoon.

title: 石中剑 Demo
description: 你是西幻故事的女主……但你是一把剑！ 斯威拉沃是一座历史悠久的城市，而你只是一把在当地图书馆中沉睡的石中剑。一切与你好像都无关紧要，直到你醒来，你被赋予了一次机会，化身成人，生活在这座城市之中。

title: Rogues & Fate Demo
description: A fast-paced two-hero inventory management roguelike. Assemble your inventory and crush bizarre creatures. Break the game with thousands of insane builds to defeat the Fate King in this RPG auto battler.

title: Untold Memories: Grandma's House Demo
description: Rick is forced to spend a week at his grandmother’s house, where every night grows more disturbing. Explore a house filled with whispers, survive paranormal events, and uncover the secret hidden beneath it all while one warning echoes in your mind: never enter the basement..

title: The Rounds of Six Demo
description: Demo version of the psychological horror The Rounds of Six. Probation period before starting work in Ward No. 6. Walk through a looped segment of the corridor, learn the basic rules of the clinic, and try to identify anomalies.

title: NODE ZERO Demo

description: Build and manage your dream resort from the ground up! Design beautiful guest rooms, welcome visitors, prepare delicious meals, and grow a small hotel into a thriving vacation paradise!

title: Crownrats Demo
description: Crownrats is a co-op colony RPG where mouse heroes explore locations, capture rooms, mine resources, build a home colony and resist rival warrens. Play solo with bots or together in quick tactical runs.

title: Doom Reignite Demo
description: The apocalypse crisis erupts again, and mutated zombies threaten the only humans left. As a member of the Atlas Doomsday Squad, explore survival in a Roguelike world with a Lowpoly art style, gather resources, refine gear, and seek a path forward for humanity.
developer: Chengdu Shengming Leyou Network Technology Co., Ltd.

title: 8BIT HUNTER Demo
description: Protect villages as an 8-Bit Hunter in this nostalgic top-down retro game! Defeat monsters, robbers, and bandits. Earn money for weapons & upgrades by completing quests.

title: Wild East: The Straw Man Demo
description: A 1990s point-and-click mystery set in post-communist Slovakia. Play as journalist Marek Varga and follow the first trail through dead ends, missing papers, old apartments, and people with reasons to lie.

title: The Duke is Dead Demo
description: The official demo for the upcoming detective game The Duke is Dead! Collect clues, solve puzzles, and use deduction to find the killer. Put your skills to the test to unravel the trail of crimes and uncover the truth!

title: Citadels - Shadow City Demo
description: Welcome to the Citadels: Shadow City DemoStep into the world of Citadels: Shadow City, a strategic turn-based card game of hidden roles, bluffing, and city-building set in a dark fantasy medieval world.In this demo, you'll get your first taste of the game's core mechanics:Build your city by constructing powerful districts.
